summary: Hamilton says he would vote to stop weapons transfers to Israel and end offensive military aid while preserving defensive weapons, telling POLITICO in October 2026 he does not want tax-funded bombs dropped on innocent people. He has declined to label Israel's actions in Gaza genocide, and his 2023 statement after the Hamas attacks expressed concern for people on both sides. Vote for Peace rates him an Ally in the general election. His campaign platform contains no Israel or Palestine policy.
